newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI 15 seeks investor for Rudniki plant.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI 15 seeks investor for Rudniki plant.

text.p: Poland's National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 15 has upped its stake in cement plant Rudniki SA to 60.6 percent from earlier 33 percent and seeks a strategic investor for the firm, an NFI official said.

Maciej Dabek, a member of the fund's management firm Creditanstalt - SCG Fund Management SA management board told a news briefing on Wednesday the fund was negotiating with foreign cement firms on taking a stake in Rudniki.
"We are negotiating with foreign firms of the sector on... either selling them the stake in Rudniki or a part of it, or a new issue of Rudniki," he said.
He added the prospective investor was likely to have more than 50 percent in the firm and said the transaction could take place this year.
He explained the NFI 15, also called Hetman, took the new issue of Rudniki in early March to assist its restructuring and help increase its value before seeking an investor.
Dabek said the fund paid 22 million zlotys for a new share issue in Rudniki, which had 4.3 percent of Polish cement market in 1996. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
